rows.source_ko: 제1조 (시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 (면허증에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 종전의 규정에 의하여 발급받은 수의사면허증은 이 규칙에 의하여 발급받은 면허증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Licenses)  Veterinarian licenses issued under the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to be licenses issued under this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 (수의사면허신청에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙은 시행전에 수의사국가시험에 합격한 자가 수의사면허를 받고자 하는 때에는 별지 제19호서식에 의한 신청서에 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여 농림수산부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Application for Veterinary License)  If a person who passed the national veterinary examination prior to the enforcement of this Rule wishes to obtain a veterinary license, they shall submit an application in accordance with Attached Form No. 19 to the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제5조제1호 및 제4호에 해당되지 아니함을 증명하는 의사의 진단서
rows.text_en: 1. A medical certificate from a physician proving that it does not fall under Article 5, subparagraphs 1 and 4 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 사진(신청일전 6월내에 촬영한 탈모정면ㆍ상반신 반명함) 1매
rows.text_en: 2. One passport-sized photograph (frontal view without head covering, upper body, taken within 6 months prior to the application date)

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (동물병원관리수의사등의 신고등에 관한 경과조치) ①이 규칙 시행당시
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Reporting, etc. by Veterinarians Managing Animal Hospitals, etc.)  ① At the time of the enforcement of this Rule

rows.source_ko: 동물병원개설자로서 관리수의사를 두고 있는 자는 이 규칙 시행일부터 6월이내에 별지 제15호서식에 의한 신고서를 도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: A person who has a supervising veterinarian as the founder of an animal hospital must submit a report in accordance with Form No. 15 to the provincial governor within six months from the effective date of this rule.

rows.source_ko: ②이 규칙 시행당시 동물병원개설자로서 그 동물병원에서 진료업무에 종사하는 수의사를 두고 있는 자는 이 규칙 시행일부터 6월이내에 제15조제1항 본문 후단, 동조제2항2호 또는 제16조제1항제2호의 규정에 의한 서류를 도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Any person who is the founder of an animal hospital at the time of enforcement of this rule and has a veterinarian engaged in medical practice at the animal hospital shall submit the documents prescribed in the latter part of the main text of Article 15, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the same article, or Subparagraph 2 of Article 16, Paragraph 1 within six months from the date of enforcement of this rule to the provincial governor.

rows.source_ko: 제5조 (진료비의 인가에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 수의사회가 종전의 규정에 의하여 도지사의 인가를 받아 정한 동물병원의 진료보수는 제19조제1항의 규정에 의하여 수의사회의 지부가 도지사의 인가를 받아 정한 동물병원의 진료비로 보되, 수의사회의 지부는 1995년 1월 31일까지 진료비의 내용을 공표하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Approval of Medical Fees)  Medical fees for animal hospitals determined by the Veterinary Medical Association under the approval of the provincial governor pursuant to the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this rule shall be deemed as medical fees for animal hospitals determined by the branch of the Veterinary Medical Association under the approval of the provincial governor pursuant to the provisions of Article 19, Paragraph 1, provided that the branch of the Veterinary Medical Association shall publish the details of the medical fees by January 31, 1995.

rows.source_ko: 제6조 (수의사연수계획에 관한 경과조치) 수의사회회장은 제26조제5항의 규정에 의한 1995년도 수의사연수계획을 1995년 2월 28일까지 농림수산부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Veterinary Training Plan)  The President of the Korean Veterinary Medical Association shall submit the 1995 veterinary training plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 26, Paragraph 5 to the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries by February 28, 1995.

rows.source_ko: 제7조 (서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 종전의 규정에 의하여 작성되어 사용중인 서식은 1995년 3월 31일까지 이 규칙에 의한 개정서식과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Transitional Measures concerning Forms)  Forms prepared and in use under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this Rule may be used together with the revised forms under this Rule until March 31, 1995.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(동물병원의 시설기준에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 전에 종전의 규정에 따른 시설기준을 갖추어 동물병원을 개설한 자는 별표 1 비고 제3호의 개정규정에 따른 시설기준을 갖춘 것으로 본다. 다만, 이 규칙 시행 후 6개월 이내에 별표 1 비고 제3호의 개정규정에 따른 시설기준을 갖추어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Facility Standards for Animal Hospitals)  Any person who established an animal hospital before the enforcement of this Rule by meeting the facility standards under the previous regulations shall be deemed to have met the facility standards under the amended provisions of Note 3 of Annex 1. However, they must meet the facility standards under the amended provisions of Note 3 of Annex 1 within six months after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Reporting of Status and Employment of Veterinarians, etc.)  ① Veterinarians who obtained a license pursuant to Article 4 of the Act or who obtained a license again pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 3 of the Act prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 14, submit a report in the form of Attached Form No. 11-2 to the head of the Veterinary Medical Association by December 31, 2025.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신고를 한 수의사는 그 신고를 한 날부터 매 3년이 되는 해의 12월 31일까지 별지 제11호의2서식의 신고서를 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A veterinarian who has made a report pursuant to Paragraph 1 must submit a report in the form of Attached Form No. 11-2 by December 31 of every third year from the date of the report.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Posting of Medical Expenses by Animal Hospital Operators)  Any person who established an animal hospital pursuant to Article 17 of the Act prior to the enforcement of this Rule and who posted medical expenses only by any one of the subparagraphs of Article 18-3, Paragraph 2 of the former Rule shall post medical expenses by the method prescribed in the amended provisions of Article 18-3, Paragraph 2 within three months after the effective date pursuant to the proviso of Article 1 of the Addenda.
